title: 2026년 11월 14일, 인공지능 분야에서 무슨 일이 일어났을까요?
intro: Coordinating many coding agents is turning into a product feature: Claude Code Projects now scopes, delegates and reviews parallel work itself, and one founder's all-agent org merged 1,119 PRs in a week.
The day's best engineering writing put agent failures outside the model, in stale repo context, drifting job state, and per-tool permissions that leak data once agents are chained.
highlights: Claude Code Projects now runs a coordinator that splits work into parallel threads and reviews the results.
An all-agent org on Amp merged 1,119 PRs in a week and grew its own bureaucracy.
Google: stale specs and resolved bugs in a repo read as instructions to coding agents.
Three agents that each respect their permissions can still leak data together.
DeepSeek opened its app's search, file, OCR and voice tools as APIs and ported DeepEP to Huawei Ascend.

categories.name: 에이전트 함대: 조정 기능이 제품에 통합되었습니다.
